# Pesher Nahum Column 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 4QpNah (Cave 4), Col. 1 | **Condition:** Fragmentary at top; lower portion better preserved

---

**1:1** [...the interpretation of-it concerns] the Kittim, wh[o...]

**1:2** [...] who are swift and mighty in-battle, to-destroy man[y...]

**1:3** [...] by-the-hand-of the Kittim and [...] and they shall trea[d...]

**1:4** "He rebukes the sea and-dries-it-up and-makes all the rivers desolate" (Nah 1:4).

**1:5** Its pesher: the sea — they are all the Kittim, wh[o...]

**1:6** [...] to-execute judgment upon-them and-to-destroy-them from-upon the face-of [the earth...]

**1:7** "The mountains quake before-Him and-the hills melt; the earth heaves before-Him, the world and-all who-dwell in-it" (Nah 1:5).

**1:8** [...] its pesher concerns [...] the earth before [...]

**1:9** [...] and-the mountains and-the hills are [...] there-is-no [...]

**1:10** [...] against the chosen-ones of-God and [...he will-gather] his [con]gregation [...]

**1:11** "Who can-stand before His indignation? And-who can-endure the heat-of His anger? His fury is-poured-out like fire, and-the rocks are-broken-asunder by-Him" (Nah 1:6).

**1:12** Its pesher: [...] in-the-earthquake [...] and the mountains [...]

**1:13** [...] and-by-fire and-by [...] through-His-messen[gers...]

**1:14** [...] which [...] the judgment of-God [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 1 preserves pesher commentary on Nahum 1:3b–6. The Kittim are identified with the biblical sea imagery — a standard sectarian cipher typically denoting foreign imperial powers (here likely the Romans or Seleucids). The quoted biblical verses are rendered in strict alignment with the Hebrew of Nahum as preserved in MT, with hyphenated construct chains. The pesher sections are heavily damaged; restorations follow standard 4QpNah scholarship (Allegro, Horgan). "Chosen ones of God" (bechirey El) is a characteristic Qumran self-designation.*
